meta.ruleDescription: final rules = the contract's deployed default (CONSERVATIVE); nothing set after deploy
meta.network: local anvil (chain id 31337) — synthetic prices, anvil test keys

cases.title: Healthy baseline
cases.description: Five sources sign $2,500 every hour for 3 hours; feed and OSM follow.

cases.title: Honest gradual movement (+0.5%/h)
cases.description: The market rises 0.5% per hour for 8 hours; every source and the feed follow.

cases.title: Legitimate strong rally (+2%/h)
cases.description: A real, sustained rally of 2% per hour for 6 hours; sources and feed report it honestly.
cases.expected: Ideally FRESH; may trip the 3% TWAP-watch band

cases.title: Temporary volatility (+6% spike, then back)
cases.description: One hour at +6%, then the price returns to $2,500 and stays there for 3 hours.
cases.expected: Brief WATCH at most; must not freeze permanently

cases.title: Extreme but legitimate move (+25% in 1 h)
cases.description: A genuine repricing: +25% within an hour, then held for 3 hours. Nothing is manipulated.
cases.expected: Policy restricts anyway (velocity ≥ 20%/h): a known false positive

cases.title: Legitimate decline (−10% in 1 h)
cases.description: A genuine −10% move. Multipli's OSM delays prices by 1 h, so the Vat briefly lends above the market.
cases.expected: Likely PROTECTIVE while the OSM lags (Vat above effective price)

cases.title: Thin-market pump, all sources honestly report it
cases.description: Governance assumes a thin market ($1,000 moves the price 1%). The market is pumped +60%; all five sources and the feed report $4,000; the OSM passes it through.

cases.title: Sudden large movement (+30% in one round)
cases.description: A +30% jump reported by every source, then held for 2 hours (default deep-market assumption).

cases.title: Sustained manipulation, thin-market assumption
cases.description: Price pumped to $4,000 and held for 9 hours — longer than the 6 h TWAP window. Depth assumption: thin.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE, then at best WATCH (cost gate) once the TWAP catches up

cases.title: Sustained manipulation, deep-market assumption
cases.description: Same 9-hour hold, but governance's depth assumption says the market is deep ($250k per 1%). Once the TWAP absorbs the pump nothing flags it.
cases.expected: Known limit: may return to FRESH after the TWAP window
cases.latencyNote: 1 poke(s) after onset · lapsed to FRESH while the risk persisted

cases.title: Creeping manipulation (+10%/h for 6 h)
cases.description: The price is walked up 10% per hour (+77% in total) instead of one jump.
cases.expected: At least WATCH (velocity ≥ 5%/h), PROTECTIVE once far from TWAP

cases.title: Sub-threshold manipulation (+2.5%)
cases.description: A small +2.5% manipulation reported by all sources. Below every watch threshold — and, at a 140% liquidation ratio, not profitable (needs > +40%).
cases.expected: Not detected: below the 3% / 5%/h thresholds (detection floor)

cases.title: 1 of 5 sources manipulated (all signatures relayed)
cases.description: 1 source sign $4,000 while the rest sign the real $2,500; the relayer submits all five signatures.

cases.title: 2 of 5 sources manipulated (all signatures relayed)
cases.description: 2 sources sign $4,000 while the rest sign the real $2,500; the relayer submits all five signatures.

cases.title: 3 of 5 sources manipulated (all signatures relayed)
cases.description: 3 sources sign $4,000 while the rest sign the real $2,500; the relayer submits all five signatures.

cases.title: 4 of 5 sources manipulated (all signatures relayed)
cases.description: 4 sources sign $4,000 while the rest sign the real $2,500; the relayer submits all five signatures.

cases.title: 3 of 5 sources collude, only their signatures relayed
cases.description: A colluding majority signs $4,000 and a malicious relayer submits only those 3 signatures. The round is cryptographically VALID; the real market (feed) is still $2,500.

checks.label: verifier accepted the colluding round (cryptographically valid)

cases.title: 4 of 5 sources collude, only their signatures relayed
cases.description: A colluding majority signs $4,000 and a malicious relayer submits only those 4 signatures. The round is cryptographically VALID; the real market (feed) is still $2,500.

checks.label: verifier accepted the colluding round (cryptographically valid)

cases.title: 5 of 5 sources collude, only their signatures relayed
cases.description: A colluding set of all five signs $4,000 and a malicious relayer submits only those 5 signatures. The round is cryptographically VALID; the real market (feed) is still $2,500.

checks.label: verifier accepted the colluding round (cryptographically valid)

cases.title: Stale upstream price while the market falls
cases.description: The market falls to $1,500. Sources report it, but the Chainlink-style feed freezes and Multipli's OSM keeps $2,500.

cases.title: Upstream feed frozen for 25 hours
cases.description: Sources keep signing a stable $2,500, but the Chainlink-style feed stops updating. Multipli's adapter flags it after its 24 h maxDelay.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE once the adapter reports stale (24 h)

cases.title: Conflicting sources (1500 / 2500 / 2510)
cases.description: Three sources disagree by far more than 1%.

cases.title: Forged price under a real signature
cases.description: A relayer edits a signed price to $9,999.

cases.title: Unauthorised signer
cases.description: A valid signature from a key outside the five sources.

cases.title: Replay of an accepted round
cases.description: An accepted round is re-submitted later.

cases.title: Stale nonce (fresh signatures, old round number)
cases.description: Newly signed attestations reuse the last round number.

cases.title: One source counted twice
cases.description: A relayer duplicates one signature to fake a 3-of-5 quorum.

cases.title: Insufficient quorum (2 signatures)
cases.description: Only two sources sign the round.

cases.title: Expired attestation
cases.description: A round valid for 60 s is submitted 2 minutes later.

cases.title: 5 of 5 sources online
cases.description: All sources sign every hour.

cases.title: 4 of 5 sources online
cases.description: One source offline; four sign every hour (one spare above quorum).

cases.title: 3 of 5 sources online (minimum quorum)
cases.description: Two sources offline; exactly the quorum signs every hour.

cases.title: 2 of 5 sources online (quorum impossible)
cases.description: 3 sources offline: no new round can reach the 3-of-5 quorum. The last accepted round ages out after maxAge (1 h). Polled every 10 minutes.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE once the last round is stale

cases.title: 1 of 5 sources online (quorum impossible)
cases.description: 4 sources offline: no new round can reach the 3-of-5 quorum. The last accepted round ages out after maxAge (1 h). Polled every 10 minutes.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE once the last round is stale

cases.title: 0 of 5 sources online (quorum impossible)
cases.description: 5 sources offline: no new round can reach the 3-of-5 quorum. The last accepted round ages out after maxAge (1 h). Polled every 10 minutes.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE once the last round is stale

cases.title: Recovery after an attack
cases.description: Conflicting sources → DISPUTED; honest rounds return. Borrowing may reopen only after a newer accepted round AND the 1 h recovery delay.
cases.expected: DISPUTED → RECOVERING → FRESH, never earlier than the delay

checks.label: borrowing reopened after new round + delay

cases.title: Relapse during recovery
cases.description: Pump → PROTECTIVE; price briefly normalises (RECOVERING); pump resumes within the recovery delay.
cases.expected: Never reopens between the two pumps

checks.label: borrowing never reopened during the episode

cases.title: Oracle outage, then recovery
cases.description: All sources go offline for 2 hours, then return.
cases.expected: PROTECTIVE → RECOVERING → FRESH after new round + delay
